mapper.select: SELECT fl.ID, fl.NAME, fl.URL, fl.LOGO, fl.DESCRIPTION, fl.LINK_TYPE, fl.EMAIL, fl.CONTACT, fl.STATUS, fl.IS_VISIBLE, fl.ALLOW_FOLLOW, fl.CHECK_ENABLED, fl.SORT, fl.CREATE_TIME, fl.UPDATE_TIME, flh.STATUS AS CHECK_STATUS, fls.CLICK_COUNT, fls.DAY_CLICK, fls.WEEK_CLICK, fls.MONTH_CLICK, fls.LAST_CLICK_TIME, (SELECT u.USERNAME FROM user u WHERE u.ID = fl.CREATE_USER) AS CREATE_USERNAME, (SELECT u.USERNAME FROM user u WHERE u.ID = fl.UPDATE_USER) AS UPDATE_USERNAME FROM friend_link fl LEFT JOIN friend_link_stat fls ON fls.LINK_ID = fl.ID LEFT JOIN friend_link_health flh ON flh.LINK_ID = fl.ID WHERE fl.ID = #{friendLinkId}

SELECT fl.ID, fl.NAME, fl.URL, fl.LOGO, fl.DESCRIPTION, fl.LINK_TYPE, fl.ALLOW_FOLLOW, fl.SORT, fl.CREATE_TIME, fls.CLICK_COUNT, fls.DAY_CLICK, fls.WEEK_CLICK, fls.MONTH_CLICK, fls.LAST_CLICK_TIME, fl.CHECK_ENABLED, flh.STATUS AS CHECK_STATUS FROM friend_link fl LEFT JOIN friend_link_stat fls ON fls.LINK_ID = fl.ID LEFT JOIN friend_link_health flh ON flh.LINK_ID = fl.ID WHERE fl.STATUS = 1 AND IS_VISIBLE = 1 AND (fl.CHECK_ENABLED = 0 || ( fl.CHECK_ENABLED = 1 AND flh.STATUS = 1 )) ORDER BY fl.SORT DESC, fl.CREATE_TIME DESC
SELECT fl.ID, fl.NAME, fl.URL FROM friend_link fl WHERE fl.STATUS = 1 AND fl.CHECK_ENABLED = 1
